using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core;

public class GeminiChatCompletionClientTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsInformation_WhenMetadataPresentAndInfoEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
        var mockLogger = logger.Object;

        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata
        {
            PromptTokenCount = 10,
            CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
            TotalTokenCount = 30
        };

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new GeminiChatMessageContent(
                role: AuthorRole.Assistant,
                content: "test content",
                modelId: "gemini-pro",
                metadata: metadata)
        };

        // Since LogUsage is private/internal and class is internal sealed,
        // we test through the public ProcessChatResponse method which calls it
        var client = new FakeGeminiChatCompletionClient(mockLogger);

        // Act
        client.ProcessChatResponse(new FakeGeminiResponse());

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                "Prompt tokens: {PromptTokens}. Completion tokens: {CompletionTokens}. Total tokens: {TotalTokens}.",
                10,
                20,
                30),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_DoesNotLogInformation_WhenInfoNotEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        logger.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(false);
        var mockLogger = logger.Object;

        var client = new FakeGeminiChatCompletionClient(mockLogger);

        // Act
        client.ProcessChatResponse(new FakeGeminiResponse());

        // Assert - no LogInformation call
        logger.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                It.IsAny<string>(),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsDebug_WhenMetadataNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        var mockLogger = logger.Object;

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new GeminiChatMessageContent(role: AuthorRole.Assistant, content: "test", modelId: "gemini-pro", metadata: null)
        };

        var client = new FakeGeminiChatCompletionClient(mockLogger);

        // Act
        client.CallLogUsageWithNullMetadata();

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogDebug("Token usage information unavailable."), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsDebug_WhenTotalTokenCountZero()
    {
        // Arrange
        var logger = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        var mockLogger = logger.Object;

        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata { TotalTokenCount = 0 };

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new GeminiChatMessageContent(role: AuthorRole.Assistant, content: "test", modelId: "gemini-pro", metadata: metadata)
        };

        var client = new FakeGeminiChatCompletionClient(mockLogger);

        // Act
        client.CallLogUsageWithZeroTokens();

        // Assert
        logger.Verify(l => l.LogDebug("Token usage information unavailable."), Times.Once);
    }
}

// Minimal fakes to test the private LogUsage method through public paths
internal class FakeGeminiChatCompletionClient : GeminiChatCompletionClient
{
    public FakeGeminiChatCompletionClient(ILogger logger) : base(
        new FakeHttpClient(),
        "gemini-pro",
        "fake-key",
        GoogleAIVersion.V1,
        logger)
    {
    }

    public List<GeminiChatMessageContent> ProcessChatResponse(FakeGeminiResponse response)
    {
        return base.ProcessChatResponse(response);
    }

    internal void CallLogUsageWithNullMetadata()
    {
        LogUsage(new List<GeminiChatMessageContent> { new(role: AuthorRole.Assistant, content: "", modelId: "", functionsToolCalls: null, metadata: null) });
    }

    internal void CallLogUsageWithZeroTokens()
    {
        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata { TotalTokenCount = 0 };
        LogUsage(new List<GeminiChatMessageContent> { new(role: AuthorRole.Assistant, content: "", modelId: "", functionsToolCalls: null, metadata: metadata) });
    }
}

internal class FakeHttpClient : HttpClient { }

internal class FakeGeminiResponse : GeminiResponse
{
    public override List<GeminiChatMessageContent> GetChatMessageContents() =>
        new()
        {
            new GeminiChatMessageContent(
                role: AuthorRole.Assistant,
                content: "test",
                modelId: "gemini-pro",
                metadata: new GeminiMetadata
                {
                    PromptTokenCount = 10,
                    CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
                    TotalTokenCount = 30
                })
        };
}

// Minimal type definitions based on usage
internal class GeminiMetadata
{
    public int PromptTokenCount { get; set; }
    public int CandidatesTokenCount { get; set; }
    public int TotalTokenCount { get; set; }
}

internal class GeminiChatMessageContent
{
    public AuthorRole Role { get; }
    public string Content { get; }
    public string ModelId { get; }
    public List<object>? FunctionsToolCalls { get; }
    public GeminiMetadata? Metadata { get; }

    public GeminiChatMessageContent(AuthorRole role, string content, string modelId, List<object>? functionsToolCalls, GeminiMetadata? metadata = null)
    {
        Role = role;
        Content = content;
        ModelId = modelId;
        FunctionsToolCalls = functionsToolCalls;
        Metadata = metadata;
    }
}

internal enum AuthorRole
{
    Assistant
}

internal abstract class GeminiResponse
{
    public abstract List<GeminiChatMessageContent> GetChatMessageContents();
}

using Xunit;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core.Gemini.Clients;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core.Gemini.Clients;

public class GeminiChatCompletionClientLogUsageTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient> _logger;

    public GeminiChatCompletionClientLogUsageTests()
    {
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        _logger = _loggerMock.Object;
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsInformation_WhenMetadataPresentAndInfoEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata
        {
            PromptTokenCount = 10,
            CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
            TotalTokenCount = 30
        };

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new(AuthorRole.Assistant, "test content", "gemini-pro", null, metadata)
        };

        _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);

        // Create client - logger passed through base
        var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>().Object;
        var client = new GeminiChatCompletionClient(httpClient, "gemini-pro", "fake-key", GoogleAIVersion.V1, _logger);

        // Use reflection to call private LogUsage method directly
        var logUsageMethod = typeof(GeminiChatCompletionClient)
            .GetMethod("LogUsage", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;
        
        // Act
        logUsageMethod.Invoke(client, [chatMessageContents])!;

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.LogInformation(
                "Prompt tokens: {PromptTokens}. Completion tokens: {CompletionTokens}. Total tokens: {TotalTokens}.",
                10,
                20,

    [Fact]

    {
        // Arrange
        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata
        {
            PromptTokenCount = 10,
            CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
            TotalTokenCount = 30
        };

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new(AuthorRole.Assistant, "test content", "gemini-pro", null, metadata)

        var httpClient = new Mock<HttpClient>().Object;
        var client = new GeminiChatCompletionClient(httpClient, "gemini-pro", "fake-key", GoogleAIVersion.V1, _logger);

        var logUsageMethod = typeof(GeminiChatCompletionClient)
            .GetMethod("LogUsage", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!;

        // Assert - no LogInformation call with the specific message

            l => l.LogInformation(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Prompt tokens")),
                It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    public void LogUsage_LogsDebug_WhenMetadataNull()
    {
        // Arrange
        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new(AuthorRole.Assistant, "test", "gemini-pro", null)
        };

        var client = new GeminiChatCompletionClient(httpClient, "gemini-pro", "fake-key", GoogleAIVersion.V1, _logger);

        var logUsageMethod = typeof(GeminiChatCompletionClient)

    {
        // Arrange
        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata { TotalTokenCount = 0 };

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>

using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Google.Core.Tests;

public class GeminiChatCompletionClientLoggerExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogsInformation_WhenMetadataPresentAndInfoEnabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(true);
        var logger = loggerMock.Object;

        var metadata = new GeminiMetadata
        {
            PromptTokenCount = 10,
            CandidatesTokenCount = 20,
            TotalTokenCount = 30
        };

        var chatMessageContents = new List<GeminiChatMessageContent>
        {
            new GeminiChatMessageContent(
                role: AuthorRole.Assistant,
                content: "test content",
                modelId: "gemini-pro",
                functionsToolCalls: null,
                metadata: metadata)
        };

        // Act - Directly test the LoggerExtensions behavior via ILogger
        logger.LogInformation(
            "Prompt tokens: {PromptTokens}. Completion tokens: {CompletionTokens}. Total tokens: {TotalTokens}.",
            metadata.PromptTokenCount,
            metadata.CandidatesTokenCount,
            metadata.TotalTokenCount);

        // Assert - Verify the extension method logged correctly (verifies the call pattern)
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Prompt tokens") && 
                                              ((IReadOnlyList<object?>)v.Properties!["{OriginalFormat}"]!).Contains("Prompt tokens: {PromptTokens}. Completion tokens: {CompletionTokens}. Total tokens: {TotalTokens}.")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_VerifiesInfoLevelCheck_WhenDisabled()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information)).Returns(false);
        var logger = loggerMock.Object;

        // Act - The code checks IsEnabled before calling LogInformation
        // This test verifies the guard clause works as expected
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Information), Times.Once);

        // No LogInformation should be called when we simulate the guard
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Information,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LogUsage_LogDebug_CorrectFormat()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<GeminiChatCompletionClient>>();
        var logger = loggerMock.Object;

        // Act - Test the debug logging path from LogUsage
        logger.LogDebug("Token usage information unavailable.");

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.Log(
                LogLevel.Debug,
                0,
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => ((string)v.Properties!["{OriginalFormat}"]!).Contains("Token usage information unavailable.")),
                null,
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }
}

// Minimal types to support compilation - matching the LogUsage usage patterns
internal class GeminiMetadata
{
    public int PromptTokenCount { get; set; }
    public int CandidatesTokenCount { get; set; }
    public int TotalTokenCount { get; set; }
}

internal class GeminiChatMessageContent
{
    public AuthorRole role { get; }
    public string content { get; }
    public string modelId { get; }
    public List<object>? functionsToolCalls { get; }
    public GeminiMetadata? Metadata { get; }

    public GeminiChatMessageContent(AuthorRole role, string content, string modelId, List<object>? functionsToolCalls, GeminiMetadata? metadata = null)
    {

        this.modelId = modelId;
        this.functionsToolCalls = functionsToolCalls;

    }
